abstract: In this report, the growth capacity of murine ascitic teratocarcinomas (embryoid bodies, EBs) was studied in certain strains of allogeneic mice. When EB was intravenously injected into Balb/c mice, various types of tumor colonies were formed with various types of differentiated tissues in the lung, as in the case of syngeneic 129/Sv mice. Tumor colonies in the abdomen of Balb/c and other allogeneic mice formed by the intraperitoneal injection of EB, however, contained merely undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma cells (EC cells) and sometimes some primitive tissues, too. Analysis of lung colonies (LCs) from EBs in Balb/c mice indicated that EC cells are a potent target for being rejected but they can escape this rejection by differentiating into various types of tissues cells.
abstract_ja: 本研究では、いくつかの系統の同種異系マウスにおけるマウス腹水型奇形癌(胚様体、EB)の増殖能を検討した。EBをBalb/cマウスに静脈内投与すると、同系の129/Svマウスの場合と同様に、肺内にさまざまな分化組織を含む種々の腫瘍コロニーが形成された。一方、他の同種異系マウスおよびBalb/cマウスに腹腔内投与したEBでは、腹腔内に形成された腫瘍コロニーは未分化な胎児性癌細胞(EC細胞)のみからなり、時に原始的な組織を含むにとどまった。Balb/cマウスの肺コロニー(LC)の解析から、EC細胞は拒絶されやすい標的であるが、さまざまな組織細胞へと分化することで拒絶を逃れうることが示された。
